contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and FND-0068 does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is orthogonal to the pure-Tate target bookkeeping and compatible with the C66-GEO-Z / C66-COMP-RANK program (determinantal rank-drop ideals for Z). Independent primary check: Fulton Intersection Theory Thm 14.4, as restated in Zhao arXiv:2408.14021v2 Prop. 2.2, gives only the inequality codim(D) ≤ expected (equivalently dim ≥ expected); Cohen–Macaulay / open-stratum lci conclusions from the determinantal package require equality with expected codimension. Strict codimension deficit therefore blocks those conclusions but does not force non-lci of the actual codimension: a component may still be generated by a regular sequence of length equal to its actual height. Hence the fallacious inference “below expected determinantal codim ⇒ nowhere-lci” is invalid, and a nowhere-lci claim needs local depth / Fitting / conormal work absent from ATT-0026. Distinct from corroborated FND-0046 (pointwise CE obstruction vs scheme-theoretic Fitting identification of Z with an Abel–Jacobi incidence locus), FND-0052 (balanced reduced-support open, not closed pure-codim-4), and FND-0058 (constant h0 needed for pure dimension 17): complementary scheme-structure hygiene, not a semantic duplicate. Merge target: none. Promote from candidate to corroborated on this independent literature verification of the commutative-algebra obstruction.

scope.does_not_assert: Does not assert that any component of Z is or is not lci; only that expected-codim deficit is not a sufficient criterion for nowhere-lci.
scope.exact_statement_scope: If a component of a degeneracy locus has actual codimension strictly below the generic Porteous/determinantal expectation (m-r)(n-r) (or the analogous k(k-e) bound), that component may still be cut out locally by a regular sequence of length equal to its actual codimension, hence may still be lci of that actual codimension. Inferring a nowhere-lci conclusion from expected-codimension deficit alone is invalid; a nowhere-lci claim requires local ideal-depth, Fitting, or conormal calculations, which ATT-0026 does not supply.
